h1: Small Space Home Fitness: Gear That Stores Away
intro: Seven pieces for the room that has to be a living room the rest of the day. Nothing here needs a spare bedroom or a rack: a mat that rolls into its own strap, bands that live in a bag by the sofa, weights that stack in a drawer. Small equipment, used often, is worth more than the machine nobody wants to look at.
seo_title: Small Space Home Fitness: Gear That Stores Away
seo_description: Seven pieces of apartment friendly workout gear that store away: a mat, a roller, bands, sliders and weights, verified picks from Evergreen House.
list_card_line: Seven pieces of workout gear that store away, for the room that has to be a living room the rest of the day.

cards.B0CRYZBNV3: Wrist and ankle weights you can add a pound at a time, then stack in a drawer.
cards.B0C8MVXKN2: A cordless jump rope that counts the work, for the ceiling you cannot swing under.
cards.B07H9PZ42P: A thick mat that stays put on a wood floor and rolls into its own strap.
cards.B0040EGNIU: A foam roller with a grid that works like a hand, for the day after leg day.
cards.B071D6SX9K: Two discs that turn any rug into a slide, and take up less room than a book.
cards.B07DWSPQQY: Five bands with handles that clip on, for a full pull workout in one square yard.
cards.B01AVDVHTI: Five loop bands in one small bag, the easiest thing to keep beside the sofa.
